summary: Minutes after taking office, {person} signs the order that carries out a promise about a fee.
realLife: Arnold Schwarzenegger acted on California’s vehicle license fee increase immediately after his inauguration.
gates: An incoming executive has made a fee pledge and the fee is in force.
weights: An approaching collection date increases pressure for an early decision.
inGame: needs: a signed fee order and its effective date.

turns.what: The fee remains in effect after inauguration.
turns.pulledBy: A legal review finds that changing it takes a vote.
turns.writesBack: The incoming executive sends a proposal to the legislature.

turns.what: The executive delays signing until collection offices can implement the change.
turns.pulledBy: Local offices need new instructions for pending renewals.
turns.writesBack: The signed order gives a later start date.
